description: Export the tenant decision ledger, including earlier process runs, as a hash-chained array of signed receipts with a chain verification result. Memory mode exports this process only. Optional agent_id, task_id and workflow_id accept identifiers only; spend_decide binds them into the signed actor. Read-only and cost-configuration tools accept these fields without recording a spend decision.

agent_id.description: Optional agent identifier; signed as actor.agentId on spend_decide

task_id.description: Optional task identifier; signed as actor.taskId on spend_decide

workflow_id.description: Optional workflow identifier; signed as actor.workflowId on spend_decide

name: export_receipts
